verdict.rationale: Asking whether an AI video-generation service publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open license for Luma's product, models, or SDKs. The SDKs and OpenAPI definitions are developer building blocks and documentation, not open-licensed product source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
